Phase 5c: Route B run and dead. MpiH3EncodeAV over source+extension (N=141, S=51, E=90 - all three forced by the 17k+5 video grid, the 3-frame audio step and the 17-frame latent step), mask over the extension only, MpiH3DecodeAV compositing back. Join 30.18 (5.56x) against the shipped one-frame pin's 2.02 (0.36x): 15x looser, and the driver changes clothes across the seam. THE MECHANISM IS NOT WHAT FAILED - F8 re-ran the same sample with the composite off (25s, ComfyUI cached the sampler) and its decoded head IS the source, so the noise mask reached the sampler and the preserved region survived every step. Composite eliminated (30.38 without it), VAE round trip eliminated (-0.83 luma over the head vs +12 at the join). H3 takes identity from the GUIDE, not from unmasked latent tokens, which makes Route B and Phase 1's MpiH3MaskedPrefix ONE mechanism rather than two. Correction: feather is a SPATIAL softener (max_pool2d+conv2d over H,W, h3.py:986-1010), a no-op on a full-frame mask and never a temporal crossfade. BLOCKED and needing Fabio's decision: MiniMaxH3AddGuide anchors a CLIP (17k+5, frame_idx in pixel frames), which is LTX's shape through the path H3 listens to, but three arms died in the sampler and a minimal-diff probe (the control with only #902 num_frames 1->39) died identically. custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Extend/patch.py monkey-patches PackedLayout.__init__ and MiniMaxH3.extra_conds at import for EVERY graph on 8188: one frame's rows per image keyframe ([4860,96] into [405,96]) and 'only first/last keyframe anchors are supported'. Phase 5d: the clip guide runs, and the seam metric was rewarding the artefact. Pack renamed .disabled and the bench restarted; both previously impossible arms then ran first time unchanged, proving the [4860,96]->[405,96] layout failure and 'only first/last keyframe anchors' were the pack's patch. MiniMaxH3AddGuide now anchors the source's last 39 frames as a CLIP at frame_idx 0 with its matching audio tail, ref_audio_1 dropped. F10a discards the model's re-take and joins hard (LTX #44/#45) at 205.5s; F10b keeps it and linear_blends the original back over all 39 frames (LTX #43) at 5.0s cached. HEADLINE: join/source-half-mean never measured smoothness, it measured STILLNESS. The control's 2.02 is a DIP - 2.0 where its own neighbours run 4.6-6.6 and the footage's ordinary motion is 5.68 - i.e. the picture nearly stops for one frame, which is exactly the 'start frame from the last frame' artefact Fabio reported. The target is 1.0x, not 0. F10b's crossfade region measures min 3.90 / max 7.47 / mean 5.59 across frames 84-124 against pure-source 5.68, no spike. Identity holds through the fade and 2.3s past it (frames 84/95/105/115/124/180 all the same woman), which no earlier arm managed. This reframes Phase 5b's table - the control's 0.36x was never the bar to beat. A build bug was caught before the numbers were read: the crossfade arm must keep the re-take, not the trimmed tail, or it blends a 1.6s time offset at full opacity with every tensor valid. ComfyUI-Manager has no reboot endpoint on this build (both routes 404). Gate is Fabio's eyes.

Fabio's gate on Phase 5d: continuation, identity and AUDIO all pass on both clip-guide arms ('their continuation is really good... the sound is good, flawless') - the guide's own audio input killed the re-sung-music problem that ran through Phase 5. One defect remains: a short transition flicker, 1-5 frames, worse on F10b. Measured before handoff and it is NOT colour - chroma is flat across the join (U +0.84, V -0.2 over 20-frame windows). It is luma: the model's RE-TAKE of the guide is up to +4.9 brighter than the original, and linear_blend ramps that in monotonically across the overlap (F10b-F10a rises 0.0 -> +4.9 from frame 85 to 117), then frames 119-124 swing 3-6 luma and drop back to 103.6 at the first pure new frame. The model's CONTINUATION sits at the source's own level - only the re-take drifts, and the re-take is exactly what the crossfade mixes. F10a's version is a single -2.4 step, compounded by the source brightening 103.8->105.9 through the overlap while the continuation does not follow. Fix order: level-match the re-take before blending, then filmic/perceptual crossfade modes (both untested; linear_blend was chosen only because flow_ltx_extend.json uses it), then guide length 56/73. Do NOT widen the overlap - the excursion scales with it. BENCH: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Extend stays renamed .disabled for this work.
